items.title: Fuel pulsation damper leak (V6)
items.summary: Improperly assembled damper on the fuel rail can tear its diaphragm and leak fuel.

items.title: Port-installed alloy wheel upgrade
items.summary: Some trucks fitted with a four-wheel alloy upgrade at the Jacksonville, FL port.

items.title: Floor mat pedal entrapment
items.summary: An unsecured or incompatible driver's mat can trap the accelerator pedal wide open.

items.title: Side curtain airbag inadvertent deployment
items.summary: Airbag control module may be programmed so curtain airbags deploy unexpectedly.

tsbs.title: Cracked, sticky or melted dashboard — warranty enhancement
tsbs.summary: Covered certain 2003–2005 4Runners for 10 years from first delivery; long expired.

timeline.change: Prado 120-based launch: 4.0 1GR-FE V6 (245 hp) or first-ever 4.7 2UZ-FE V8 (235 hp); X-REAS optional; HAC and DAC on 4WD

V6 head gaskets: Autotrader says failures on 2003–05 V6s are reported more than average, and Expedition Portal owners put most of them in 2003–04. Wikipedia dates the revised gasket to late in the 2006 model year
TPMS standard; optional third-row seat (first seven-seat 4Runner)
V8 gains VVT-i (≈270 hp / 315 lb-ft); five-speed auto standard on the V6
Mid-cycle refresh: new bumpers and grille, projector headlamps, LED tail lamps. HotCars picks the 2006-on V8 trucks as the better buys, and late-2006 V6s get the revised head gasket
Curtain and front side airbags standard; VSC-off switch; Urban Runner package on Sport V6 4x4
Trail Edition: factory rear e-locker, A-TRAC switch and Bilstein dampers

identify.intro: The V6/V8 split changes the whole drivetrain, and the only factory-lockered 4th gen is a one-year package.

items.head: Model codes
items.body: US trucks are GRN210/215 (4.0 1GR-FE V6) or UZN210/215 (4.7 2UZ-FE V8).

items.head: 4WD system
items.body: V8 4WD trucks are full-time; V6 trucks are part-time or Multi-Mode. Both use a lockable Torsen centre diff.

items.head: Trail Edition (2009)
items.body: The only 4th gen with a factory rear e-locker, plus an A-TRAC switch and Bilstein dampers. Check for the locker switch before paying a Trail premium.

items.head: X-REAS and rear air
items.body: X-REAS cross-linked dampers were standard on the Sport Edition and optional elsewhere; some Limiteds also have rear height-adjustable air suspension. Both are costly to replace like-for-like.

items.head: Pre- or post-facelift
items.body: 2006-on trucks have round fog lamps with the turn signals in the headlamps, projector headlamps and LED tail lamps.

values.intro: Mostly still cheap, but low-mile V8s and clean late trucks have broken away from the pack.
values.note: Based on 23 Bring a Trailer sales from November 2025 to October 2026 (median about $13,750). The top two were low-mile 2006–07 V8 4WD trucks at $35,000–39,000.
